description: For a piece of scientific work someone wants done — 'annotate a phage genome', 'deconvolve bulk RNA-seq into cell types', 'check assembly completeness', 'dock a ligand', 'fit an IC50', 'process accelerometer data', 'call variants', 'find CRISPR arrays' — return how it is done on Corollary: the stages in order, the programs, models and databases used, what commonly goes wrong, and the page that starts it. Use this when the user wants a task done rather than a model named.

task.description: The work the user wants done, in plain words.

name: how_to_run_science_task
title: How to do a scientific analysis on Corollary
